title: CNC Milling & Turning Machinist
description: Seeking skilled CNC Milling and Turning Machinists for precision engineering components manufacturing in Jurong, Singapore.
responsibilities: Operate and program 3-axis / 5-axis CNC Milling & Turning centers (Fanuc / Heidenhain / Siemens).
Read technical drawings and blueprints to produce high-precision aerospace, oil & gas, and semiconductor components.
Perform dimensional checks using vernier calipers, micrometers, and height gauges.
Maintain tooling, work holding, and ensure workplace safety under Singapore MOM standards.
requirements: Minimum 3 years CNC operating or programming experience.
Valid Indian passport with at least 18 months validity.
Ability to understand basic technical English.
benefits: Overtime pay (1.5x / 2.0x standard rate)
Company subsidized hostel accommodation or housing allowance
Comprehensive medical and hospitalization insurance covered by employer
Annual leave and public holiday benefits as per Singapore Employment Act

ITI / Diploma certificates and mark sheets

title: 6G Pipe Welder (TIG & ARC)
description: Urgent opening for certified 6G TIG and Shielded Metal Arc Welders (SMAW) for marine shipyard construction and offshore fabrication in Tuas, Singapore.
responsibilities: Perform high-quality 6G position TIG root and ARC fill welding on carbon steel, stainless steel, and alloy pipes.
Ensure all welds pass 100% radiographic (X-ray) and ultrasonic testing inspections.
Carry out joint beveling, fit-up alignment, pre-heating, and post-weld interpass temperature control.
Strictly adhere to shipyard safety protocols, confined space entry, and hot-work permits.
requirements: Proven 6G welding qualification with previous shipyard or plant experience.
Valid passport with at least 18 months validity.
Good physical stamina and ability to work in marine shipyard conditions.
benefits: High overtime availability with enhanced overtime allowances
Shipyard dormitory accommodation provided with transport to worksite
MOM compliant medical insurance and work injury compensation
Safety gear, welding PPE, and protective equipment provided
requiredDocuments: Work experience certificates from previous employers
Horizontal and vertical welding demonstration video
